decisions.decision: The board stated it would not make any decisions at this meeting on the negotiated PILOT amounts for EPG Solar.

decisions.decision: Once Mass PV 1 has its permits through the Planning Board, the board would open discussion with Mass PV 1 on a PILOT.

decisions.decision: The board will vote on Mass PV's request for a warrant change for STM at its 9/4/12 meeting.

decisions.decision: The board will meet the following Tuesday to finalize all warrant information; the warrant stays open until then if Mass PV is to be included.

budget_items.topic: EPG Solar land valuation and real estate tax
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Scheid estimated the Twin City parcel land valuation and the resulting annual real estate tax on the 43 leased acres.
budget_items.quote: he estimated that the twin city parcel land valuation is at approximately $250,000 which yields approximately $4,300 per year in real estate tax

budget_items.topic: Full and Fair Cash Value of solar personal property
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Scheid estimated the 20-year average full and fair cash value of the project's personal property, including the SREC value, per MW per year.
budget_items.quote: would amount to approximately $50k-$55k per mw, per year, which includes the value of the solar renewable energy certificate (srec bill)

budget_items.topic: Shrewsbury assessor tax per MW comparison
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Speidel reported Shrewsbury's assessor reached a tax per MW close to EPG's presented figure; about $11K per MW if credits are removed.
budget_items.quote: had come up with a tax per mw which was much closer to what epg had presented which was approximately $14k per mw.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Londa reported distribution, transmission and transition costs rose over ten years, with a 6.2% annual increase.
budget_items.quote: ten years ago the cost of distribution, transmission, and transition was less than 7 cents per kwh and currently its just less than 12 cents per kwh

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three amounts were printed beside the warrant and payroll/commitment entries; the minutes do not clearly map each amount to a warrant, so the pairing is not stated.
